english.title: Person other than motor vehicle keeper fail to supply information re user
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required by or on behalf of the

(A)_[Chief Officer of Police for **(..SPECIFY FORCE..)]_
(B)_[Secretary of State]_

to give information which it was in your power to give and which might have led to the identification of the

(C)_[driver]_
(D)_[user]_

of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was alleged to have been used on a road

(E)_[without a vehicle licence in contravention of section 29]_
(F)_[in excess of the authority of a trade licence in contravention of section 34]_
(G)_[without the higher rate of duty having been paid in contravention of section 37]_

of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994, failed to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46(4) and (5) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
